name: @stewardmd/capacitor-sknx-vision
description: EXPERIMENTAL on-device dermatology image classifier. iOS runs a HAM10000 MobileNetV3 (7-class) via Core ML (built into iOS, Neural Engine). The photo never leaves the device — only the 7-class probability vector is returned. Uncalibrated public model; the SknX guardrail decides referral. Model downloaded on first use.
author: StewardMD
_note: iOS-only for now (Core ML, zero third-party runtime). Android (ONNX Runtime AAR) added after iOS is device-validated; then add capacitor.android.src + android/* to files.
